fact: The High Constitutional Court ruled on 26 August 2025 that law no. 2025-019 on the identification of natural persons, adopted by the National Assembly on 3 July and the Senate on 4 July 2025, conforms to the Constitution; the President had referred it on 28 July 2025 for review before promulgation, and the decision does not state that it was promulgated.
